hd_new_year_resolution.text: It's January and you've announced a resolution to anyone who will listen. By day three it already looks tired.

outcomes.works: Weeks later you're still at it. Annoyingly, it's working.
outcomes.quits: You last nine days. The guilt lasts longer.

hd_new_years_hangover.text: January 1st. Your head is a drum, your mouth is a carpet, and last night is mostly rumour.

choices.run: Sweat it out with a run

outcomes.clear: Somewhere around the second kilometre you feel reborn.
outcomes.puke: The park bin gets the worst of it. Happy new year.

hd_snow_day.text: You wake to a white world. Everything is cancelled and the street has become a playground.

hd_tax_forms.text: Tax-form season. A pile of paper asks you things about your life that you'd rather not answer.

hd_valentine_dating.text: Valentine's Day. {{name}} has been dropping hints for a week, roughly the size of billboards.

hd_valentine_single.text: Valentine's Day. Every shop window is pink, and every couple on your street is suspiciously holding hands.

outcomes.nothing: Forty swipes, zero sparks and a drained battery.

hd_big_game_party.text: It's the night of the big game. Friends crowd your living room, the wings are already gone, and nobody can agree on who to root for.

outcomes.win: Against all odds, they win. You collect, loudly.
outcomes.lose: They fold in the second half. Your wallet follows.

hd_leap_day.text: It's February 29th, a day that barely exists. It feels like permission to do something you normally wouldn't.

hd_purim_party.text: Purim. Everyone is in costume, there's a noise-maker in every hand, and somebody has already dropped a tray of hamantaschen.

choices.costume: Go all out on a costume

hd_spring_cleaning.text: Spring arrives and the closet has declared war. You open it and a coat from three years ago falls out.

hd_march_storm.text: A March storm rolls in with grey sky, hard rain and wind that tries to take your umbrella.

outcomes.fun: You splash through puddles like a kid again.
outcomes.soaked: Soaked to the bone. The cold arrives by evening.

hd_purim_mishloach.text: Purim again. You have a pile of treat baskets to deliver and a list of people you'd rather not visit.

outcomes.crush: Your anonymous basket is the talk of the building.
outcomes.mixup: It goes to the wrong door. A stranger thanks you warmly.

hd_april_fools_victim.text: It's April 1st and you have a bad feeling. Your coffee tastes slightly of salt and your phone is full of strange messages.

hd_april_fools_prank.text: April 1st. You have a perfect prank in mind and a victim sleeping peacefully in the next room.

hd_passover_seder.text: Passover seder. The table is full of relatives, the story is long, and {{name}} keeps glancing at you whenever the questions come around.

hd_spring_break.text: Spring break. Everyone you know is heading to the coast. Your bank account says no, but your friends say yes.

outcomes.wild: Sun, sand, and one story you'll never tell your mother.
outcomes.burn: Sunburn, a stolen phone, and a decent time anyway.

hd_mothers_day.text: It's Mother's Day. {{name}} has put up with you for years, and a card feels small.

hd_lag_baomer.text: Lag BaOmer. The hill glows with bonfires, the air smells of smoke and baked potatoes, and every kid is carrying a stick.

choices.potato: Roast a potato in the coals

hd_graduation_season.text: Graduation season. Gowns, caps and speeches everywhere. Somebody else's ceremony makes you think about yours.

hd_may_heatwave.text: A May heatwave hits early. The city smells of melting tar and every fan is already sold out.

choices.pool: Spend the day in a pool
choices.run: Go for a midday jog anyway

hd_fathers_day.text: It's Father's Day. {{name}} insists he wants nothing, which is the usual trap.

hd_pride_parade.text: Pride parade day. Music, glitter and flags everywhere. The whole street feels like a party that makes sense.

outcomes.calm: Your calm reply ends the shouting.
outcomes.heat: The argument goes nowhere and gets louder.

hd_summer_wedding.text: A wedding invitation arrives on thick cream paper. Costly gift, itchy suit, and a seating chart that puts you next to the divorced uncle.

hd_exam_memories.text: Exam season again, but you're just a bystander this time. Students look pale, and your own old exams come rushing back.

choices.coffee: Bring a friend coffee and snacks

hd_jellyfish.text: A perfect beach day. The water is warm, the sky is blue, and something translucent just brushed your leg.

hd_bbq_fail.text: You volunteer to run the grill. The coals are lit, the guests are hungry, and you have no idea what you are doing.

outcomes.chef: Juicy, smoky, applauded. A grill master is born.
outcomes.fire: A flare-up takes your eyebrows and the sausages.

hd_fireworks.text: Summer fireworks light the sky over the water. Every bang makes the whole crowd gasp at once.

choices.pets: Stay home with a scared pet

outcomes.fun: Loud, bright, stupid, and nobody gets hurt.
outcomes.hurt: A rocket goes sideways. Burns and a fine follow.

hd_heat_stroke.text: It's forty degrees in the shade. The world is shimmering, you've sweated through everything, and the dizziness is not a joke.

choices.shade: Get to shade and drink water
choices.ice: Dump ice water on your head

hd_vacation_traffic.text: You're finally leaving for vacation, along with everyone else on earth. The highway is a parking lot and the kids in the next car are staring at you.

hd_summer_job_ends.text: Your summer job is over. The last shift ended with a handshake, a small envelope, and a vague promise to stay in touch.

hd_back_to_school_shopping.text: Back-to-school shopping. The supply list is long, the crowds are loud, and your favourite pen costs triple.

outcomes.found: A bin of discounted notebooks saves the day.
outcomes.empty: Everything good is gone. You pay full price.

hd_meteor_shower.text: It's the night of the meteor shower. The sky is clear, the city lights are far, and streaks of light cross the dark.

outcomes.magic: You see forty shooting stars. You talk until sunrise.
outcomes.tired: Clouds roll in. You see two, and sleep through work.

hd_rosh_hashanah.text: Rosh Hashanah dinner. Round challah, a table groaning with food, and relatives who ask about your plans for the coming year.

hd_new_year_gym.text: September feels like a second January. You stand in front of the gym with a signup form and a rush of optimism.

hd_first_day_nostalgia.text: September hits you in the nose: freshly sharpened pencils, new backpacks on the street. You remember your own first day of school.

hd_apple_honey.text: The holiday table is set for apples and honey. A small slip, and the entire honey jar tips toward your lap.

choices.clean: Try to wipe it up fast

outcomes.clean: No stain, no witnesses. Pure luck.
outcomes.sticky: Now the chair, the tablecloth and your sleeve are one sweet mess.

hd_yom_kippur.text: Yom Kippur. The streets are empty and silent, kids ride bikes down the middle of the road, and you haven't eaten since yesterday.

outcomes.clear: Hunger passes into clarity. You think about what you owe.
outcomes.faint: Dizzy by afternoon. You break the fast with a headache.

hd_sukkah.text: Sukkot. You and {{name}} are supposed to build the sukkah. It comes with a box of poles, a bag of sticks and a very strong opinion about how it's done.

hd_halloween_party.text: A Halloween party invitation lands on your phone. The theme: 'Come as your worst fear'.

hd_pumpkin_spice.text: A friend swears that pumpkin spice is the taste of autumn. Another friend says it's a crime. Both turn to look at you.

hd_black_friday.text: Big sale day. Shoppers stampede through the doors, pushing like it's a rescue operation, and a toaster is the grand prize.

outcomes.win: You emerge bruised but with a ridiculously cheap TV.
outcomes.lose: An elbow to the ribs, and an expensive impulse buy.

hd_family_dinner.text: Thanksgiving-style family dinner. The turkey is dry, the table is crowded, and your awkward uncle starts a 'question for the young generation'.

outcomes.point: You land a good point. The table stays silent.
outcomes.scene: Voices rise. Someone leaves with a plate of leftovers.

hd_charity_drive.text: A charity drive is collecting food and coats for the winter. A box sits in the lobby, mostly empty.

hd_movember.text: November. A friend bets you can't grow a moustache for the month. The money goes to a good cause.

hd_hanukkah.text: Hanukkah. The candles flicker in the window, the kitchen smells of oil, and {{name}} is already eating jelly doughnuts straight from the tray.

hd_nye_kiss_dating.text: New Year's Eve. The countdown begins, glasses rise, and {{name}} is looking straight at you.

choices.quiet: Slip away for a quiet toast

outcomes.movie: The street cheers. You both laugh into the kiss.
outcomes.sloppy: Mistimed and clumsy. Fireworks go off over your embarrassment.

hd_nye_kiss_single.text: New Year's Eve. The clock hits midnight and you're standing in a crowd of couples, holding a glass and the world's smallest hopes.

outcomes.spark: A good kiss and a phone number. The year starts well.
outcomes.slap: Wrong stranger. A drink in the face as a resolution.

hd_gift_exchange.text: The gift exchange draw is done and you've got a name. Budget limit: twenty dollars. The person is nearly a stranger.
